scope: input files -> portable command -> new result files -> semantic status in CLAIMS.json

quick.command: python -B -X utf8 replay/replay.py --mode quick --output <new folder outside bundle>

extended.command: python -B -X utf8 replay/replay.py --mode extended --output <new folder outside bundle>

inputs: nine unchanged WL scripts listed by replay_wolfram.ps1
Wolfram.external_dependency: separately licensed Wolfram kernel; captured connected-service rerun is bundled

status_mapping: CLAIMS.json separates computation verification from PASS/FAIL/CONDITIONAL/SCAN_ONLY/SOURCE_BLOCKED/PROVENANCE_PENDING/NOT_RUN scientific status
